```yaml
name: Run Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Set up shellcheck
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck
    
    - name: Run shellcheck
      run: |
        find . -name "*.sh" -not -path "./.git/*" | xargs shellcheck
    
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        chmod +x ./test.sh
        ./test.sh
```
